topTextureShare.lowestLevel.description: share of the lowest level's cells whose dominant texture is its top texture; none when the lowest level is the main level

topTextureShare.mainLevel.description: share of the main level's cells whose dominant texture is its top texture

topTextureShare.highestLevel.description: share of the highest level's cells whose dominant texture is its top texture; none when the highest level is the main level

cliffTextureChange.downIntoPit.description: share of cliff crossings down into a pit (below the main level) whose dominant texture differs 2 cells back on each side

cliffTextureChange.upOntoHeight.description: share of cliff crossings up onto a height (above the main level) whose dominant texture differs 2 cells back on each side

doodadDensity.lowestLevel.description: the lowest level's share of the visible doodads over its share of the ground (1 = as dense as the map); none when the lowest level is the main level

doodadDensity.mainLevel.description: the main level's share of the visible doodads over its share of the ground (1 = as dense as the map)

doodadDensity.highestLevel.description: the highest level's share of the visible doodads over its share of the ground (1 = as dense as the map); none when the highest level is the main level

doodadDensity.perHundredCells.description: visible doodads on playable ground per 100 playable, non-ramp cells

frameAreas.singleTextureShare.description: share of frame-sized areas (18x12 cells) on the main level holding one texture, a texture counting from 0.5% of an area

blend.nearBorderShare.description: share of blended cells (two or more textures each giving 10%) within 2 cells of a border between dominant textures

blend.width.description: blended cells within 2 cells of a border, per cell side of border between dominant textures on playable ground: roughly the blend band's mean width in cells, from thin seams (near 0) to wide soft blends (at most about 5)

blend.singleTextureCellShare.description: share of playable cells with only one texture giving 10% or more

yawSnapping.natural.description: share of visible natural props (rocks, trees, foliage) turned to within a degree of a 45-degree step

yawSnapping.built.description: share of visible built props (ruins and other structures) turned to within a degree of a 45-degree step

yawSnapping.decal.description: share of visible decals turned to within a degree of a 45-degree step

backdrop.share.description: share of the playable, non-ramp ground below the main level (the backdrop: pits, abyss floors, void)

backdrop.waterShare.description: share of the backdrop under a water or lava area

backdrop.skyShare.description: share of the backdrop on a hidden lowest level, showing the sky

backdrop.coveredShare.description: share of the backdrop under water or lava or showing the sky

backdrop.fogDensity.description: the map's tileset fog density, its own CTerrain's where it sets one; 0 with fog off

lighting.lightsSet.description: distinct lights the map's triggers set (GameSetLighting)

lighting.changes.description: GameSetLighting calls in the map's triggers

lighting.instantShare.description: share of the triggers' lighting changes that cut at once (a blend time of 0)

lighting.longestBlendSeconds.description: the longest blend time of a trigger's lighting change, in seconds

lighting.pointLightShare.description: share of all doodads that are point lights (LightOmni)

lighting.pointLightsPerHundredCells.description: point lights (LightOmni) per 100 playable, non-ramp cells
